assumptions.choice: 1% risk is computed against current live portfolio value (self.broker.getvalue()) at signal time, not fixed initial cash.
assumptions.reason: Spec says '1% of capital' without specifying static vs. mark-to-market capital; live equity is the standard convention for risk-based sizing.

assumptions.choice: The 2*ATR figure is used only inside the position-sizing formula (risk_amount / (2*ATR)); no separate protective stop-loss order is submitted.
assumptions.reason: The spec's only explicit exit rule is the 5-trading-day time exit; the '2*ATR from entry' phrase appears solely within the sizing example, so adding a real stop order would introduce an exit condition the spec never states.

assumptions.choice: Computed share size is truncated to a whole number via int().
assumptions.reason: Spec is silent on fractional shares; backtrader's default broker trades whole share quantities.

assumptions.choice: The 5-trading-day hold is counted from the bar on which the entry order actually fills (one bar after the Monday signal, per market-order execution), not from the signal bar itself.
assumptions.reason: Spec doesn't specify whether the count starts at signal or fill; the fill bar is the actual moment the position exists.

assumptions.choice: Skip opening a new position that week if ATR(14) <= 0.
assumptions.reason: Purely a numerical safety guard against division by zero in the sizing formula, not an added trading filter.
